test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}

CREATE TABLE test_wide_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64, c1 UInt64, c2 UInt64, c3 UInt64, c4 UInt64, c5 UInt64, c6 UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}
CREATE TABLE test_str_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}
CREATE TABLE t_skew90 (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY if(sipHash64(a) % 10 < 9, 0, 1 + sipHash64(a) % 15)
CREATE TABLE test_plain (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_{partitions} SELECT number % 100000, number FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO test_wide_{partitions} SELECT number % 100000, number, number * 2, number * 3, number * 5, number * 7, number * 11, number * 13, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO test_str_{partitions} SELECT number % 100000, number, randomPrintableASCII(100) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_skew90 SELECT number % 100000, number FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO test_plain SELECT number % 100000, number FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT a, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) FROM test_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT a, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b DESC) FROM test_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT a, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a, b % 10) FROM test_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT a, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b), avg(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b DESC) FROM test_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT *, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) FROM test_wide_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT a, s, count(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a) FROM test_str_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT a, s, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) FROM test_str_{partitions} FORMAT Null
SELECT a, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) FROM t_skew90 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, sum(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b), avg(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b DESC) FROM test_plain FORMAT Null
